title: Chapter 4 · AI Mock 1
instructions: Original AI-authored challenging practice inspired by topics and style in the available teacher quizzes. Not a teacher paper or official mark scheme. Work independently under timed conditions; self-mark against the model points after submission.
description: Timed teacher-inspired mock with written answers and model marking points.

questions.text: Complete the truth table for Y = (A AND B) OR NOT A by listing Y for inputs 00, 01, 10, 11.

answer.text: NOT A is 1 when A is 0; A AND B is 1 only when both inputs are 1

questions.text: A warning activates if temperature T is high and either door D is open or override O is active. Write a Boolean expression.

answer.text: T must be true and at least one of D or O must be true

questions.text: Simplify (A AND B) OR (A AND NOT B). Justify.

answer.text: Factor A; B OR NOT B is 1

questions.text: A NAND gate has inputs 1 and 1. State its output and explain.

answer.text: AND gives 1, then the output is inverted
